summary: Atomic offline redaction maintenance, catalog identity and backup roundtrip passed retained remote regression tests on the recorded source. RC51 native backfill and purge each passed dry-run, mutation and idempotence against an owned full-schema smoke database copy. Historical RC46 ingest-stamping evidence remains separately scoped. Producing-bead bundle closeout and signed release qualification remain pending. This file does not certify deployment corpus cleanliness.

catalog.fingerprint_algorithm: SHA-256 of domain frankenterm-secret-catalog-v2 NUL sequential-regex-replace-all NUL, then UTF-8 fields framed by u64 big-endian byte lengths: default marker, named marker template, and each ordered family name plus actual regex expression
catalog.reproducible: redactor::secret_catalog_version is canonical; the names below alone cannot reconstruct expression-sensitive identity. The retained remote catalog-identity and manifest-schema tests verified this fingerprint against the live implementation.

ingest_stamping.pre_v29_rows: NULL = catalog unknown; a successful non-dry-run sweep stamps the applied catalog on every scanned row atomically with its receipt. This column identifies the last applied catalog, not immutable capture provenance.

properties: idempotent content rewrites; every completed real sweep records a receipt including zero-rewrite scans
one SQLite transaction covers row rewrites, catalog adoption, configured SQLite derived-store maintenance, and mandatory receipt; failure rolls back
derived-store rebuild: output_segments_fts FTS5 + segment_embeddings invalidation

purge.note: run_redact_purge transaction, receipt and dry-run controls passed remotely. Only active-catalog matches are eligible. Sealed backups require separate review.

verification.claim: Scoped remote maintenance, catalog and backup regression proof; release manifest remains deferred until producing-bead bundle qualification completes.
verification.not_claimed: No whole-corpus cleanliness claim: scans are per-segment, resumed scans exclude earlier rows, and catalog coverage is finite. Tantivy rebuild_requested records required external work; no rebuild is queued or performed. mmap mirrors, archived backups and external indexes are not certified by a SQLite maintenance receipt.

retained_remote_receipts.scope: Filtered library suite includes catalog expression/order controls, real SQLite backfill/purge receipts, rollback and dry-run controls, and backup roundtrip. The named live-catalog attestation test also passed. This is not a whole-workspace or release-profile pass.

scoped_source_comparison.method: git diff from the tested commit to the RC51 source commit returned no changes for these four files; their current bytes were hashed independently
scoped_source_comparison.limit: Source equality is limited to the listed files. Dependencies, the rest of the workspace and native execution are not qualified by this comparison. Native maintenance has its own receipt below.

native_ingest_receipt.scope: Owned RC46 native DSR smoke database only; all three captured rows carry the catalog fingerprint above. No backfill or purge was performed. The diagnostic DSR build later timed out during packaging and is not a publishable release.

native_maintenance_receipt.scope: Native CLI over a read-only SQLite backup of the stopped owned RC51 smoke database. Each operation scans two added synthetic rows after cursor 3; original rows and embeddings are preserved. Real mutation validates catalog stamping, SQLite FTS rebuild, embedding invalidation and durable receipt equality. Dry-run preserves database bytes and state; repetition changes no content or embeddings.
native_maintenance_receipt.provenance_boundary: The identity receipt records root's independent terminal DSR success and offline family verification review. The maintenance driver verifies executable hash binding but does not establish provenance itself.

verification.release_qualification: Pending producing-bead bundle build/verify, manifest completeness, retained evidence packaging and signed release qualification. RC51 native maintenance passed for the exact source and executable above; this does not qualify other release gates. Referenced external receipts must be retained with the release evidence; this artifact alone does not embed their bytes.
